scroll_state.title: Scroll Position
scroll_state.description: Represents the active vertical reading percentage for a specific web page.

url.description: The exact absolute web URL of the page.

percent.description: Percentage float of scroll position (between 0 and 1).

updatedAt.description: The server-validated timestamp of when the scroll position last updated.

/users/{userId}/scroll_states/{urlHash}.description: Stores user reading positions indexed by a deterministic alphanumeric hash of the page URL.
